items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: Miff Mole, I have a reason to say Miff Mole knocked me out, because I've heard a battle of three trombones right at Small's Paradise - Miff Mole, Jack Teagarden, and -

ctx.x: I was tryin' to say that OK, so you just told us that you didn't listen to the Bessie Smith records at this point in time. But you were interested in being an advanced musician. On the other side of the coin, what are some records illustrating the more modern sounds as you interpreted that that was on record that you listened to at that time, who were you listening to?
Well, I just got through telling you about the Goofus Five and things like that and the Clarence Williams Five. Then I listened to groups, like the white groups like Red Nichols and Miff Mole and -
Did you consider any of them particularly advanced players?
